snippet.title: Tsubasa Heaven - [All Endings]
snippet.description:
Tsubasa Heaven (つばさヘブン) is a short horror visual novel made by 乃花こより (Koyori Nohana)/cream△ (@koyorinohana)  and was submitted for the ティラノゲームフェス2018 (Tyrano Game Festival 2018) on NovelGame.jp. The game was fan translated unofficially into English by ijedi1234, which can be implemented as a patch to the original Japanese version of the game.

One night, high school teacher Kuzuki happens to meet his student Haneishi at a convenience store. He works at the school and goes to dinner with her without telling his pregnant wife... Will that act send him to heaven or hell?

Game:
Freem!: https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17839
NovelGame:  https://novelgame.jp/games/show/895
English patch on Itch.io: https://ijedi1234.itch.io/tsubasa-heaven-english-patch
